assistant.intro: Hi 👋 I can look up the contracts, digital signatures and payment ledger you can see. I only read; I never change data.
assistant.suggest1: Which contracts expire in the next 60 days?
assistant.suggest3: Which digital signatures expire this month?
assistant.question: Question for the assistant
assistant.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
assistant.errForbidden: You can't use the AI assistant yet. Ask an admin to grant access in Agent Hub.
assistant.errBusy: The assistant is busy with the previous question. Try again in a moment.
assistant.errGeneric: Couldn't send the question. Try again later.
assistant.srcSeeQuote: See this passage in the source text
assistant.srcNotFound: The exact quote wasn't found in the text (the AI may have reworded it). The full text is shown below.
assistant.askHint: The assistant answers only from this contract's text and details, with quotes. The conversation is kept in your assistant history.
assistant.askPlaceholder: Ask about this contract: penalties, payment, term…
